item.title: Open call: Live Music Lab 2026 training programme
item.description: Applications have opened for the 2026 edition of Live Music Lab, a fully funded training programme aimed at young people in Johannesburg seeking entry-level experience in the live music industry. The three-month programme, run by live music platform Bassline, will select 10 participants for an intensive combination of classroom learning and practical industry exposure. item.title: Wizkid and Asake release new collaborative single Jogodo
item.description: Nigerian artists Wizkid and Asake have released a new collaborative single, ‘Jogodo’, marking their latest joint project and the lead release from an upcoming EP titled REAL, Vol. 1. The track, released on 16 January, blends Afrobeats with prominent percussion and brass elements. Sung primarily in Nigerian Pidgin, ‘Jogodo’ centres on the idea of intoxication or being under the influence, a theme reflected in both its lyrics and relaxed, rhythmic production. item.title: Ayra Starr nominated in two categories at 2026 MOBO Awards
item.description: Nigerian singer Ayra Starr has received two nominations at the 2026 MOBO Awards, competing in both the Best African Music Act and Best International Act categories. Starr, who made history last year as the first African woman to win both awards simultaneously, faces a competitive field in this year’s edition. item.title: Cover star interview: Nigeria’s Afro-house artist Damie
item.description: Rising Nigerian Afro-house artist and producer Damie joined Nandi Madida via FaceTime on Apple Music to talk about his latest single ‘One Minute’. item.title: Second Pretoria date added to UB40 featuring Ali Campbell SA tour
item.description: Promoters have added an additional Pretoria concert to the upcoming South African tour by UB40 Featuring Ali Campbell after the group’s initial show at SunBet Arena, Time Square sold out. The newly announced performance will take place on 7 June 2026, at the same venue. item.title: Open call: 2026 Pro Helvetia residency programme
item.description: Pro Helvetia has opened its annual call for its international residency programme, which supports artistic exchange, research and professional development through extended stays in new cultural contexts. The programme allows selected artists and cultural practitioners to spend up to three months in Switzerland or in regions served by Pro Helvetia’s liaison offices. item.title: SA rapper Usimamane featured on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa
item.description: South African rapper Usimamane will feature on Apple Music’s Rap Life Africa this month, as host Nandi Madida and global editorial head of hip hop and R&B, Ebro Darden, discuss his latest single, Racks, and his project G-Wagon Music: Baby Tai. Hailing from Umlazi, Usimamane has emerged as one of South Africa’s rising hip hop voices. item.title: Maskandi Fest Johannesburg to celebrate Zulu music, culture on 23 May
item.description: Maskandi Fest Johannesburg will take place on 23 May 2026 at Mary Fitzgerald Square, bringing traditional Zulu music and cultural expression to the city in a full-day event scheduled from 10am to 8pm. The festival coincides with Mother’s Day celebrations and is positioned as a family-oriented cultural gathering. item.title: Bubele Booi to debut as Vumaala at Johannesburg performance
item.description: Grammy-nominated producer Bubele Booi will stage a live performance on 23 January, marking the debut of his work as a performer under the name Vumaala. The event, titled Moya, will take place at The Artistry in Sandton, Johannesburg. It will also coincide with the release of Vumaala’s new single, ‘Memeza’, which will be made available on the day of the performance. ‘Memeza’ features South African artist Masi Buzani from the Eastern Cape. item.title: SA: Vusi Mahlasela announces new album
item.description: South African music veteran Vusi Mahlasela, widely regarded as “The Voice,” is preparing a major comeback with a new album scheduled for release in February 2026. Known for his distinctive blend of folk, jazz, and African rhythms, Mahlasela has been a prominent figure in the nation’s music scene for over three decades.
